name: anvil-skills
description: The anvil workflow for Claude Code: eight skills that scope, build, verify and review, and distil your corrections back into the context files they read.

plugins.name: anvil-skills
plugins.description: Correct Claude once and it stays corrected. Every skill logs what you fixed and where it got stuck; /feedback distils those logs into context files under hard line budgets, so they stay small enough to be worth reading on every run.
